newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa Hoechst to sell unit to parent.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa Hoechst to sell unit to parent.

text.p: Hoechst South Africa Ltd (Hoechst SA) said on Monday it had entered into talks with a view to selling its speciality chemicals unit to a merged entity in which it's parent would have a stake.

This move follows news earlier this year that Hoechst AG, the holding company of the South African based Hoechst, and Clariant AG had announced their intention to combine their speciality chemicals interests.
Hoechst SA had said at the time that it was exploring the benefits to be gained from this merger.
Shareholders were advised to exercise caution in their share dealings.
